---
title: "Events"
output-file: eventos.html
---

Full catalogue of social and political events used to explain trend changes across the
studies. Every event has a primary source (or is flagged as secondary-sourced until
confirmed). Filter by type, scope, theme, or period.

```{ojs}
eventos = FileAttachment("eventos.json").json()
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof filtroTipo = Inputs.select(
  ["All", ...new Set(eventos.map((d) => d.tipo))],
  { label: "Type" }
)
viewof filtroAmbito = Inputs.select(
  ["All", "PT", "UE", "Mundo"],
  { label: "Scope" }
)
viewof filtroTema = Inputs.select(
  ["All", ...new Set(eventos.flatMap((d) => (d.temas || "").split(";").map((t) => t.trim()).filter(Boolean)))],
  { label: "Theme" }
)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
eventosFiltrados = eventos.filter((d) => {
  if (filtroTipo !== "All" && d.tipo !== filtroTipo) return false;
  if (filtroAmbito !== "All" && d.ambito !== filtroAmbito) return false;
  if (filtroTema !== "All" && !(d.temas || "").split(";").map((t) => t.trim()).includes(filtroTema)) return false;
  return true;
})

Inputs.table(eventosFiltrados, {
  columns: ["data_inicio", "ambito", "tipo", "titulo_en", "fonte_primaria_url", "verificado"],
  header: {
    data_inicio: "Date",
    ambito: "Scope",
    tipo: "Type",
    titulo_en: "Title",
    fonte_primaria_url: "Primary source",
    verificado: "Verified",
  },
})
```
